name: Veteran arrival officer
design: Towering aged male with pale sandy hide, pronounced exposed tusks and heavy ridged forehead, thick grey dreadlocks to waist. Long dark double-breasted style alien coat with staggered bronze fasteners, broad structured collar, soft faded teal belt sash, two long skirt tails. A thin navigational staff-like pointer held vertical at side with rounded nonweapon tip; small folded folio at belt. Upright dignified posture.
